project_2.name: Fashion Trend Forecasting Model
project_2.description: Demand forecasting model on 31.7M H&M transactions testing whether Google Trends search volume predicts fashion purchase behavior
key_findings: Prophet beats 3-month rolling average baseline in all 4 categories
Swimwear Google Trends signal predicts purchases 1 week in advance (r=0.88, p<0.001)
Trousers has no significant search signal (r=0.11, p=0.27) — category granularity matters
Sweater model tuned from 21.3% to 16.77% WMAPE by increasing Fourier order from 10 to 20

project_3.name: TBD — Secondhand Fashion Valuation Model
project_3.problem_statement: Pricing secondhand fashion is subjective, inconsistent, and often manipulated. Unlike tech resale which has clear valuation frameworks (condition grades, market comps, depreciation curves), fashion resale lacks systematic valuation because aesthetics, trend cycles, and cultural cachet affect value in ways current platforms don't model well.
why_interesting: Clear commercial application — The RealReal, Vestiaire Collective, Grailed all struggle with this
Connects to existing Project 2 work — trend forecasting directly informs resale value timing
Technically feasible in 3-4 weeks without building a full marketplace
Business-heavy framing — this is a strategic analysis + prototype, not a data pipeline
project_3.what_it_is_not: A full marketplace or startup. This is a demonstration of skills — strategic thinking, data analysis, business framing, and a working prototype.
project_3.format: Founder memo + working prototype. Like a hackathon — the idea and presentation matter as much as the code.
what_it_needs_to_prove: Strategic thinking — identify a real gap and build a defensible point of view
Business literacy — understand the commercial context
Technical credibility — working model or prototype
Unique take — something that couldn't have come from a generic portfolio builder
possible_components: Analysis of how current resale platforms price items and where they fail
A valuation model incorporating trend data, brand equity signals, condition, and timing
Connection to Project 2 trend forecasting — how does search volume and trend cycle position affect resale price?
A simple working prototype or dashboard demonstrating the model
A 2-page strategic brief framing the problem and solution
still_to_decide: Is this the right project or is there a better angle?
Exact scope and what the output looks like
